name: instance_method_class_constant_writes
source:
class Consts
  LIST = [1, [2, 3]]
  H = {a: {b: 1}}

  def poke() -> string
    LIST[0] = 9
    LIST.inspect
  end

  def nested() -> array<string>
    LIST[1][0] = 20
    H["a"]["c"] = 5
    [LIST.inspect, H.inspect]
  end

  def compound() -> array<string>
    LIST[0] += 10
    H["z"] ||= 7
    [LIST.inspect, H.inspect]
  end

  def member() -> string
    H["a"] = 5
    H.inspect
  end

  def blocky() -> string
    [1].each { LIST[0] = 99 }
    LIST.inspect
  end

  def read() -> array<string>
    [LIST.inspect, H.inspect]
  end

  def self.read() -> array<string>
    [LIST.inspect, H.inspect]
  end
end

def run(input: any) -> array<string | array<string>>
  c = Consts.new
  [c.poke, c.nested, c.compound, c.blocky, c.member, c.read, Consts.read, Consts::LIST.inspect]
end
